<div class="card-body">
'''Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">中型連射ブラスター・キャノン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の位置に配備する。1フォース余分に支払うことにより、2名の戦士で移動させることができる。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が、2フォース消費して同じか隣接する位置にいる2名のキャラクターを目標として起動できる。運命数を2枚引く。運命数＞能力値の合計で、両方のキャラクターに命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Medium-Repeating-Blaster-Cannon-PSA-80497042.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">マーソン・マークII連射式ブラスター。様々な種類の動力源を使用できるため、補給物資に事欠く反乱軍にとっては使い勝手がよい。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at any location. Two warriors may move it by paying 1 extra Force. Your warrior at the same place may spend 2 Force to fire at two characters at the same or adjacent location. Draw two destiny. Both characters are hit if destiny exceeds total ability.

'''Lore:'''
A Merr-Sonn Mark II repeating blaster. It can use many kinds of power sources, so it is convenient for Rebels who often lack supplies.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 固定兵器.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
